content.title: Happy Easter! 105 Sweet Easter Wishes to Send All Your Favorite Bunnies
content.text: Happy Easter! How will you be celebrating? You can use these Easter messages in greeting cards, emails or even a text message to let your favorite bunnies know they’re on your minds and that you’re sending them warm Easter wishes. Take a peek at this curated list of ideas for funny, religious and thoughtful Easter wishes that you can send to anyone—from your grandmother to your co-worker! Out of all these Easter greeting ideas, choose the one that best reflects you and your loved one, write it in your correspondence of choice, and send it off! Remember: Even if you can’t see your loved ones this holiday, it’s always the thought that counts.
